children: Legacy Education Inc. reported full-year 2026 revenue of $80.06M and net income of $9.14M, with diluted EPS of $0.66, reflecting year-over-year growth as enrollment and recent acquisitions supported expanded operations.
Revenue was $80.06M, compared with $64.17M in the prior year; YoY change 24.8%.
Net income was $9.14M, compared with $7.53M in the prior year; YoY change 21.4%.
Diluted EPS was $0.66, compared with $0.59 in the prior year; YoY change 11.9%.
Revenue growth of 24.8% to $80.1M was driven by a 9% enrollment increase to 3,377 students and the full-year contribution from CCMCC.
New student starts totaled 3,483 and the company expanded its campus footprint across four accredited colleges to support program diversity.
Program and accreditation momentum included Integrity earning NLN CNEA accreditation for its RN-to-BSN program (June 2025); CCMCC plans to add cardiac, MRI and veterinary programs in FY2027.
Operational capacity increased with added instructional staffing, expanded branches (including HDMC Temecula) and a planned CCC Houston campus lease scheduled to open November 2026.
Cash and liquidity strengthened, supporting ongoing operations, capital expenditures and campus expansion plans.
